prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pearland, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1215; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you reported in Pearland, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: Please don't use my name in the file, just refer to me as the claimant. I'm fine with the rest.

Q: Understood. Can you describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened?

A: I was driving in the right lane of a multi-lane road in Pearland, heading toward a turn. Traffic had slowed, so I moved left to get around a parked delivery truck that was partly blocking the lane ahead.

Q: Did you signal before you changed lanes?

A: Yes, I activated my left turn signal and checked my mirror. I didn't see anything beside me when I started to move over.

Q: What happened next?

A: The other vehicle was in the left lane, and it came alongside me as I was merging. We made contact along the passenger side of my car and the driver's side of theirs. It was a scraping impact, but the force pushed my car toward the curb.

Q: Did either vehicle leave the roadway?

A: No, I stayed on the road and pulled onto the shoulder once I could control the car.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: My neck is stiff and sore, and I have a dull ache across my lower back. I got checked at an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. They diagnosed a neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to physical therapy.

Q: Have you had any prior injuries to your neck or back?

A: No, nothing that required treatment. I've had normal aches from sitting at a desk, but nothing like this.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want the repair shop and the medical providers to have my full records. I'm willing to sign any authorizations you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
